name: Bilbao
registryBasis: The Diputación Foral de Bizkaia publishes its own public cadastral parcel WFS, separate from the Spanish national Catastro. Its advertised EPSG:25830 parcel extent covers the supplied Bilbao WUP point. The actual schema was inspected first and a 2 m bbox query around that point returned one full parcel polygon. Only cadastral IDs and geometry are retained; no area, building, owner, address or legal-title attributes are retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
scopeLimits: 79 valid distinct cadastral-reference polygons verified in thirteen bounded 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged Bilbao WUP settlement locator. Complete bounded paging, forced three-row pages, all 79 fresh native parcel-identity reads, explicit absence, footprint and source binding passed in 27 requests. Independent metric EPSG:32630 GEOS found all geometries valid and distinct, with no sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. The separate Bizkaia foral cadastre uses the native municipality/polygon/parcel integer tuple; OBJECTID is only a transport key. A fresh EPSG:25830 REST tuple query matches the prior official WFS sample to below 0.000001 metres without editing coordinates. Requested EPSG:4326 geometry is retained unchanged. Wider municipal completeness, legal title, currentness, survey accuracy and long-term key continuity remain unverified.

officialSources.observation: Official Diputación Foral de Bizkaia dataset description identifies the Foral Catastro, states the WFS is a feature service for Bizkaia cadastral parcels, provides a WFS resource, public access and CC BY 4.0. Dataset update listed 20 April 2026.
Official dataset-resource page identifies the exact parcel WFS, “servicio de entidades”, public access and CC BY 4.0; resource page last modified 27 June 2025.

Official Bizkaia INSPIRE portal separates cadastral parcel/address WFS (Annex I) from building WFS (Annex III), documents city/territory service scope and CC BY 3.0 ES terms. Parcel service used here; no building/admin-boundary layer used.
Official GeoBizkaia OGC catalog lists cadastral parcel WMS and other mapping services; the separate official OpenData/INSPIRE WFS is the vector download source.

Anonymous official WFS GetCapabilities returned HTTP 200, text/xml. `Katastro_Catastro_WFS:Parcelas` advertises EPSG:25830 (default), EPSG:4326 and EPSG:3857; Bilbao coordinates are inside its advertised WGS84 bounding box.

geometrySample.schemaFirst: DescribeFeatureType inspected before feature request. Parcelas fields were OBJECTID:int, Codigo_Mun:int, Codigo_Pol:int, Codigo_Par:int, SHAPE:gml:MultiSurfacePropertyType, Area:double. Safe allowlist was OBJECTID + three cadastral code IDs + SHAPE; Area present in response was discarded.
